items.title: File Widerspruch against the Versagung (refusal of Sondernutzungserlaubnis)
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, an das Bezirksamt Musterwerder, Wasserturmweg 3, 22089 Hamburg zu richten, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter is dated Thu 19.11.2026 and was sent by ordinary post. Under §41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG a letter posted by an authority counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 19.11. + 4 days = Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this 4-day fiction itself). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then starts the following day under §187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. 24.11.2026, and ends one month later under §188 Abs. 2 BGB on 23.12.2026. Wed 23.12.2026 is a normal working day in Hamburg (not a weekend or public holiday), so no further shift is needed. To arrive safely by then, the Widerspruch should be sent by about 17.12.2026.

warnings: The 'freiwilliger Informationsabend über unsere neuen Online-Dienste' on 30.12.2026 is explicitly voluntary with no registration needed, so it carries no obligation or consequence if skipped — listed only for completeness.

No payment is requested in this letter; the IBAN printed in the letterhead (Hamburger Landesmusterkasse) is the district office's general collection account shown on all its letters, not a demand to pay — do not transfer any money based on this letter alone.
